verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform explicitly provides a Sandbox environment for sending test data, separate from production. Production keys are issued only after passing a demo, so testing is gated away from live data. missing for 10: in-depth sandbox documentation (test data sets, parity with production, rate limits), clarity on whether the sandbox covers both Case Status and FOIA APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
